title: EditContext and inline widgets
blurb: A 2D canvas code editor driven by EditContext, with inline drawable colour, range, select and button widgets drawn inside the lines of code.
question: Can canvas.editContext = new EditContext() drive text editing, selection and IME composition on a drawable <canvas> while live <input drawable>, <select drawable> and <button drawable> widgets sit inline inside the same canvas without breaking keystrokes, focus, Tab order or IME?
